list.title: How to Use Body Sunscreen Spray?
list.content:
Step 1
Shake the bottle and keep it 1-2 inches away from your body.
Step 2
Spray generously around your body and gently massage it in
Step 3
For best results, repeat every 2 hours

list.title: Important Information
list.content:
Patch tests are an easy way to make sure you don't experience any initial negative reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test prior to starting any new product on your skin. You can conduct a patch test by following the below steps:
1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow
2. Keep the area dry
3. Leave on for 12-24 hours (or lesser if the product isn’t a leave-on product)
4. If any redness, itching or irritation is observed at any time during the test do not use the product, else you can safely use it

list.title: Can I use this sunscreen spray on face?
list.content: This is recommended only for your body.

list.title: Is it safe for all skin types?
list.content: Yes - it has SunCat DE, which makes it safe even for sensitive skin.

list.title: After how many hours, should I reapply this?
How long will it take to absorb into the skin?
list.content: It takes only 3 seconds post application to absorb into the skin.
